# Emil Kowalski's skills (unchanged copy)

These seven skills are the work of **Emil Kowalski**, not ours. We used them while we built the animations in our app, and we keep a copy here so the motion part of this repo is in one place.

- Source: https://github.com/emilkowalski/skills
- Copied at upstream commit `d16ebe6` (2026-09-24). The files are byte-for-byte unchanged.
- License: MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Emil Kowalski. The full text is in `LICENSE` next to this file.
- Copied skills: `emil-design-eng`, `apple-design`, `animate`, `review-animations`, `improve-animations`, `find-animation-opportunities`, `animation-vocabulary`.
- The upstream repo has more skills. This copy only holds the motion skills we used.

We are not affiliated with Emil Kowalski, and he does not endorse this repo.

**For the latest version, install from the source, not from this copy:**

```bash
npx skills@latest add emilkowalski/skills
```

Emil writes about these skills at https://emilkowal.ski and keeps a newsletter at https://aiforui.dev/skills.

The skills are written for the web (CSS, React, Framer Motion). The principles carry over to mobile. For the Compose Multiplatform side, see `skills/kmp-compose-motion` in this repo.
